content: The tokenizers crate implements a 4-stage pipeline: Normalizer, PreTokenizer, Model (BPE/WordPiece), PostProcessor. Load from pretrained via Tokenizer::from_pretrained() or from files. encode() returns Encoding with get_tokens(). Uses Rayon for CPU parallelism. Supports batch encoding, padding, truncation. Rust-native implementation matching HuggingFace Python tokenizers.
